description: The Code Quality Analysis Script project aims to develop a robust tool that evaluates codebases against key quality metrics. This script will assess various aspects of the code, including readability, which measures how easily the code can be understood; complexity, which gauges the intricacy of the code structure; and adherence to established coding standards, ensuring that the code meets industry best practices. The script will not only analyze the code but also provide actionable improvement suggestions to enhance overall code quality. By automating this analysis, developers can save time, reduce technical debt, and improve maintainability. The final deliverable will be a fully functional script, along with comprehensive documentation detailing its usage and the metrics it evaluates, ensuring that clients can easily integrate it into their development workflows.
deliverables: Fully functional code quality analysis script (work)
Documentation detailing script usage and metrics evaluated (document)
Report summarizing analysis results and improvement suggestions (document)
